{{Quote|The kid ran into something, and it wasn't just the cold.|Han Solo, referring to Luke Skywalker's wampa attack|<ref name="ESB novel">[[Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode V: The Empire Strikes Back'' novelization]]</ref>}}
'''Wampa''' ice creatures were [[Diet/Legends|carnivorous]] predatory [[Reptomammal/Legends|reptomammals]] indigenous to the remote [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] ice [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. The bipedal beasts stood over two [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in height with shaggy [[Color/Legends|white]] fur constantly stained with the gore of slaughtered prey. Wampas were armed with jagged [[Color/Legends|yellow]] [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]] and deadly claws. Primarily solitary hunters, wampas occasionally hunted in packs, preferring to ambush their prey from the camouflage of Hoth's snow banks and blizzards. Stunned victims were carried back to the creatures' lairs, typically large ice caves, where the wampas ate at their leisure. The planet's omnivorous [[Tauntaun/Legends|tauntauns]] formed the bulk of the wampas' prey, although they would attack anything they encountered. The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] on Hoth came under constant wampa assaults in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].

While rarely seen away from their remote [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], wampas were known to have participated in illegal [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiatorial]] combat venues. They were highly valued among [[Big game hunter/Legends|big-game hunters]] for the challenge that came with [[Hunting/Legends|hunting]] the creatures, as well as for their pelts, stuffed heads, and other miscellaneous souvenirs that commanded high prices on the [[Black market/Legends|black market]]. Wampas were later protected under legislation to prevent endangered [[Species/Legends|species]] from falling into extinction by the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]].

==Biology and appearance==
{{Quote|You're talking about a predator two and a half meters tall, sometimes weighing two hundred kilograms or more, with razor-sharp teeth and claws. They're singularly vicious creatures.|[[Vesto Slipher]], [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]]|<ref name="Maul: Lockdown" />}}
Covered with shaggy [[Color/Legends|white]] [[Hair/Legends|fur]], standing at heights of up to three [[Meter/Legends|meters]],<ref name="NEGAS" /> and weighing an average of 150 [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]],<ref name="Head-to-Head" /> [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth's]] wampa [[Water/Legends|ice]] creatures were lethal predatory beasts. They possessed long, powerful [[Limb/Legends|arms]], razor-sharp claws capable of carving layers out of ice, and a [[Tooth/Legends|fanged]] maw.<ref name="NEGAS" /> Aided by an acute sense of smell and a well-camouflaged coat of thick fur, the [[Diet/Legends|carnivorous]] wampas roamed Hoth's icy plains preying on near-helpless animals.<ref name="GG3">[[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back'', Second Edition]]</ref> Wampas ranged in height from 2.20 to three meters,<ref name="BTM" /> with an average height of 2.50 meters,<ref name="NEGAS" /> weighed up to and occasionally exceeding 200 kilograms,<ref name="Maul: Lockdown" /> and had eerie yellow [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="CSWE-Wampa">{{CSWECite|III|318|wampa ice creature}}</ref> Adult wampas possessed short, jagged, curving horns, which were an indication of age. The horns began to appear at the onset of puberty and continued to grow larger as the wampa aged.<ref name="NEGAS" /> Wampas' horns were similar to those of Hoth's native [[Tauntaun/Legends|tauntauns]], though the two [[Species/Legends|species]] were entirely unrelated.<ref name="Fact File 21">{{FactFile|21|HOT 7-10|Hoth &ndash; Animals}}</ref> Wampas had a single [[Heart/Legends|heart]] within their thoracic cavity.<ref name="Maul: Lockdown" />

[[File:Wampa-woswfg.jpg|thumb|left|250px|A wampa preferred moving on all fours except when attacking prey.]]
Wampas were classified officially as [[Reptomammal/Legends|reptomammals]], creatures combining the best defensive characteristics of [[Reptile/Legends|reptiles]] with the more adaptable physiologies of [[Mammal/Legends|mammals]]<ref name="Wildlife" />&mdash;specifically, they were linked to [[Primate/Legends|primates]].<ref name="NEGAS" /> The species shared multiple physiological traits with the similarly named [[trompa]], and most xeno-biologists speculated the two species were cousins.<ref name="Rescued Aliens">{{Wizards|url=starwars/article.asp?x=sw20011129b_trompa&c=rpg|text=Rescued Aliens: The Trompa}}</ref> The wampa physiology was well adapted to conserving heat in the extreme cold.<ref name="Wampa Databank">{{DB|creature|wampa|wampa ice creature}}</ref> Beneath their protective fur was a layer of blubber for greater insulation. They were also physiologically equipped with a self-regulating metabolism.<ref name="Wildlife" /> Wampas comprised 11 percent of Hoth's total indigenous animal population.<ref name="Under the Ice">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20031204hoth|text=Hoth: Under the Ice|int=Hoth: Under the Ice}}</ref>

The wampa reigned at the top of the Hoth food chain as the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] most violent alpha predator.<ref name="Fact File 21" /> With their strong sense of smell, coat of thick white fur, which blended in perfectly with the icy landscape of Hoth, and brute strength, wampas made excellent natural hunters.<ref name="NEGAS" /> A single powerful blow from a wampa's forearm was enough to neutralize the largest prey, while the creature's bite was [[Death/Legends|deadly]].<ref name="Fact File 21" /> Very rarely were wampas themselves the victims of predators<ref name="NEGAS" />&mdash;in fact, the creatures had no natural enemies except for other wampas.<ref name="Fact File 21" /> Wampas typically traveled on two or four legs, preferring four except during an attack.<ref name="Wildlife" /> The creatures stalked their prey until reaching close enough proximity to make a rush attack. A wampa would take a final sighting of its target by rising on its hind legs and then springing forward in a deadly pounce with claws outstretched,<ref name="Fact File 21" /> though it could only swing one claw at a time due to their massive size.<ref name="Rescued Aliens" />

In terms of the creature's diet, wampas subsisted primarily on Hoth's many varieties of omnivorous tauntauns,<ref name="GG3" /><ref name="CSWE-Wampa" /><ref name="Scaly Tauntaun">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20030403tauntaun|series=Creature Feature|text=Scaly Tauntaun}}</ref> although they also hunted lumbering [[Icetromper/Legends|icetromper]] herd beasts,<ref name="Codex: Icetromper">{{TORcite|type=codex|Icetromper}}</ref> antlered mammals called [[Rayboo/Legends|rayboo]], and other, smaller unwary creatures<ref name="NEGAS" />&mdash;as well as attacking anyone or anything else they encountered that might seem to be a source of food if particularly hungry. The powerful wampa required large amounts of food to sustain itself, and a single tauntaun was enough to nourish one wampa for a considerable period. Wampa family groups, in particular, required a substantial supply of meat, since a [[Gender/Legends|female]] wampa could birth up to three cubs at once. However, the competition among wampas for Hoth's relatively small number of prey animals formed a limit to the numbers of the creatures existing on Hoth, keeping the wampa relatively scarce.<ref name="Fact File 21" />

[[File:WampaAttacksTauntaun-TEA.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Wampas preyed on tauntauns as their primary source of food.]]
Wampas were particularly sensitive to high-pitched noises,<ref name="BTM" /> sounds that were similar to those made by a female in search of a mate.<ref name="NEGAS" /> While wampas were naturally well-insulated against the Hoth elements,<ref name="Wampa Databank" /> as a result of their dense fur, they were made almost invisible to<ref name="Fact File 51">{{FactFile|51|HOT 11-12|Hoth &ndash; Wampa Ice Cave}}</ref> most standard life-form [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] scans, which is how they managed to avoid detection by Republic xeno-biologists for so long.<ref name="Wampa Databank" />

Wampas were even said to possess, at least in one case, the capacity to retain long-term memory.<ref name="Wampa Databank" /> During the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] occupation of Hoth during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] was attacked by a [[One-Arm|wampa]] while patrolling the planet's ice wastes, but he escaped the creature's clutches after [[Cho sun/Legends|slicing off]] its arm with [[Anakin Skywalker's second lightsaber/Legends|his lightsaber]]. Almost a [[Standard decade/Legends|decade]] later, during a return visit to Hoth, Skywalker re-encountered the same wampa whose arm he severed [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before.<ref name="NEGAS" /> Skywalker claimed that the one-armed beast remembered both him and his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].<ref name="Wampa Databank" />

One male wampa, named [[Ku-Kak]], had a rare, natural [[Force-sensitive/Legends|affinity]] for [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].<ref name="A Mon Alone">{{LivingForce|A Mon Alone}}</ref> Another, the giant wampa [[Unkajo/Legends|Unkajo]], towered at a height much greater than the species' average height of 2.5 meters.<ref name="NEGAS" /><ref name="Galaxies Chapter 11">{{GalaxiesAED}} {{C|Chapter 11: The Battle of Echo Base}}''<nowiki/>''</ref><ref name="Secrets of Hoth">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=68039&month=102008|text=Friday Feature &ndash; Secrets of Hoth}}</ref> Still another [[Giant Wampa Creature|giant wampa creature]], larger than ordinary wampas, lived on Hoth during the early portion of the Galactic Civil War. This giant wampa possessed a freezing breath as a natural weapon.<ref name="Super Empire Strikes Back">''[[Super Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back]]''</ref><ref name="Super Empire Strikes Back Game Secrets">''[[Super Empire Strikes Back Official Game Secrets]]''</ref>

===Subspecies===
Subspecies of wampa were found on other worlds, clearly transplanted there from Hoth, though [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] were unable to determine the exact method by which this occurred.<ref name="NEGAS" /> These subspecies included the [[cliff wampa]], a beast [[Bioengineering/Legends|bioengineered]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and used as a sentinel on the rocky [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Gall/Legends|Gall]],<ref name="NEGAS" /><ref name="SWI">{{InsiderCite|33|Wampa Attack!}}</ref> and the [[swamp wampa]] of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]].<ref name="NEGAS" /><ref name="JKM">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith]]''</ref>

Swamp wampas were identical to the Hoth wampa in almost every way, prompting scientists to theorize that they were directly descended from them. Though the exact nature of the swamp wampa's development was unclear, it nevertheless indicated a strong adaptability of the wampa species. There also existed [[Tatooine Howler]]s, colloquially named "desert wampas" for their strong resemblance to wampas. Although their appearance, with heavy fur and tusks, was similar, genetic testing proved no relation between the Howler and the wampa.<ref name="NEGAS" />

==Behavior and intelligence==
{{Quote|We thought they were dumb brutes&mdash;all teeth and claws, and no brains&mdash;but we were wrong.|Burrk, a former stormtrooper turned big-game hunter|<ref name="Darksaber">[[Darksaber (novel)|''Darksaber'']]</ref>}}
===Hunting patterns and ice cave habitat===
{{Quote|The lair was a foul place. I could smell the blood and entrails in the snow.|Unattributed|<ref name="Fact File 21" />}}
Wampas were typically solitary hunters.<ref name="NEGAS" /> They wandered the frozen wastelands of Hoth in search of food,<ref name="CSWE-Wampa" /> often stalking their prey for some [[Time/Legends|time]]<ref name="Fact File 21" /> before finally taking the victim by stealth and surprise due to their natural white-fur camouflage.<ref name="CSWE-Wampa" /> Wampas hunted both by day and, at shorter range, during Hoth's bitterly cold night.<ref name="Fact File 2">{{FactFile|2|HOT 1-6|Hoth}}</ref> Although the tauntaun, a wampa's primary source of food,<ref name="CSWE-Wampa" /> was relatively plentiful on Hoth,<ref name="NEGAS" /> the scarcity of available wildlife on the planet meant<ref name="Fact File 21" /> that a single wampa had to cover a territory of more than a hundred [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] when seeking prey.<ref name="CSWE-Wampa" /> However, wampas learned to adapt to this necessity. They emitted a very faint scent, preventing tauntauns from detecting a wampa's approach. Their white fur, blending perfectly with their environment, enabled wampas to attack their prey without prior detection.<ref name="BTM" /> As such, wampas rarely engaged in extended chases.<ref name="Wildlife" /> Icetrompers, however, proved something of an exception&mdash;their multiple set of eyes made sneaking up on the giant herd beasts a difficult proposition for even the stealthiest wampas.<ref name="Codex: Icetromper" />

[[File:Wampawcubs_woswfg.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A female and cubs in a cave with stored tauntaun food]]
The comfort zone for a wampa seeking prey was limited to Hoth's frozen plains and the cooler regions of the planet's subterranean caves. Often, Hoth's [[scaly tauntaun]]s would gather among warmer cave areas heated by bubbling pools as a defensive measure, areas that wampas found to be uncomfortably hot.<ref name="Scaly Tauntaun" /> Nevertheless, if hungry enough, wampas were known to ignore their extreme discomfort by venturing deep into these cave systems at night and during Hoth's blizzards.<ref name="NEGAS" /> They would utilize cunning methods to draw the scaly tauntauns out of their sanctuaries, sometimes rushing into the heated areas to scare their prey out into the cold where they might be cornered. Other times, wampas would simply stalk their prey by waiting in the colder regions between these heated tunnels until the tauntauns ran from one tunnel to another.<ref name="Scaly Tauntaun" />

Wampas rarely killed their prey outright<ref name="GG3" /> and never hunted when they were hungry.<ref name="CSWE-Wampa" /> Because they preferred fresh meat, wampas instead always tried to stun their prey, keeping their victims unconscious, but alive, until ready to feed.<ref name="Fact File 21" /> After disabling their prey, wampas hauled the still-breathing victims back to their cave dwellings<ref name="NEGAS" /> and, through different methods, secured them in the ice for later consumption. For some, wampas used their hot breath to melt the ice around a victim's legs and then coated parts of the body in saliva, placing them against the ice ceiling of their caves so they would freeze in place. The saliva also served as an anesthetic in the victims, which helped to keep prey comatose until the wampa was ready to eat. Alternatively, for larger creatures, such as the tauntaun,<ref name="Fact File 21" /> wampas frequently impaled them through the ankles on overhanging icicles<ref name="Wildlife" /> or stalactites to keep them immobile. At times, several fresh victims were stored in this manner.<ref name="Fact File 21" />

Hanging their still-living victims from the cave's ice ceiling allowed wampas to keep their food in good condition and then snack at their leisure&mdash;tales existed of victims taking some days to die as the wampa slowly devoured them.<ref name="Fact File 51" /> This storage method also allowed wampas to return to the ice fields to continue hunting while the hostile Hoth weather held.<ref name="Fact File 2" /> Wampa lairs often housed huge amounts of food, a testament to how deadly a single beast could be.<ref name="GG3" /><ref name="Wildlife" />

The creatures typically made their homes in one or more ice caverns,<ref name="Fact File 2" /> created by digging out a huge lair beneath Hoth's ice surface large enough to nest and store food in.<ref name="CSWE-Wampa" /> Still, wampas rarely wasted their own energy hollowing out their own caves. Instead, they usually found a pre-existing lair or former tauntaun-dug site to occupy, sometimes ejecting the original inhabitant. Wampas would also sometimes make enlargements to these caves, especially when raising young.<ref name="Fact File 51" /> Nesting wampas typically shed their guard fur, which was gathered and used to line their caverns with, though opinion was divided among [[Zoologist/Legends|zoologists]] whether this actually amounted to intelligent behavior or merely animal instinct.<ref name="Fact File 21" /><ref name="Wildlife" /> The dense guard fur lining made wampa caves almost invisible to standard scans.<ref name="Fact File 51" />

Wampas, solitary by nature, were nomadic in the sense that they rarely stayed in one cave for very long, unless they were with young. They regularly relocated to new lairs both out of the need to follow migrating tauntaun herds, and of the necessity to find cleaner dwellings. Wampas, males in particular, were remarkably messy animals, and their caves were constantly scattered with half-eaten corpses, decomposing entrails, and other [[Blood/Legends|bloody]], rotting remains. Even nursing females, aside from their fur-lined nests in which cubs were born, lived in gore-filled caves. This rotting mess quickly made wampa caves uninhabitable, forcing the creatures to find new abodes.<ref name="Fact File 51" />

===Reproduction method and societal characteristics===
{{Quote|They worked together, in coordinated attacks, probably to defend themselves from what they perceived as an invasion of their territory.|Rebel Alliance historian [[Voren Na'al/Legends|Voren Na'al]]|<ref name="TrilogySourcebook">''[[The Movie Trilogy Sourcebook]]''</ref>}}
Wampas mated during the warmer [[Standard month/Legends|months]] of the Hoth yearly cycle, during which time they gathered in regions where game was plentiful, to search for companionship. While the females remained together and waited, the males would go off in search of prey. After making a kill, the male wampa would commonly smear the blood of his victim across his chest and return with the dead animal to show the females, thus demonstrating his ability to care for a mate. Sometimes the males would spar with one another for a particular female's companionship. The winners of these bouts chose their preferred mates. They were then considered the alpha males of that region until the following mating season.<ref name="NEGAS" />

[[File:HothWampaCaveAll.jpg|thumb|right|270px|Wampas carved out cavernous lairs beneath Hoth's icy surface with their clawed hands.]]
In terms of their reproduction methods, wampas could be considered [[marsupial]]s. Their cubs were born live, but very underdeveloped, closely resembling a miniature [[Worm/Legends|worm]] small enough to fit on a [[Caf/Legends|caf]] [[Spoon/Legends|spoon]].<ref name="NEGAS" /> After mating, female wampas would birth up to three cubs per litter.<ref name="Wildlife" /> These infants, after birth, would crawl to their mothers' pouches, where they nursed, grew, and developed over a period of roughly three months&mdash;after which time they left the pouch with a full set of yellow teeth, needle-sharp claws, and an innate attitude of invincibility.<ref name="NEGAS" /> Mothers would produce [[Milk/Legends|milk]] to nurse their young<ref name="Wildlife" /> until the cubs were able to sustain themselves on meat alone. Wampa mothers were extremely protective of their offspring, and during the nursing period even males didn't risk the consequences of coming between a mother and her cubs.<ref name="Fact File 21" /> As they grew, young wampas were taught how to hunt, survive in the cold, and how to care for game from their mothers and fathers.<ref name="NEGAS" />

Wampas were extremely territorial creatures, fiercely guarding their hunting grounds against any invaders to their domain, and often engaging in bouts to the death with other wampas encroaching on their land.<ref name="BTM" /> The scarcity of Hoth's wildlife meant that a single wampa required a large hunting ground in order to survive, which was believed to be the primary reason why the creatures lived alone or in small family-based groups. Because of the substantial amounts of food required to sustain a wampa, they often extended their territory over enormous areas. Upon reaching maturity, younger wampas set out to claim territory of their own, competing with other wampas, including members of their own family, for territorial control, which contributed to keeping the species relatively scarce.<ref name="Fact File 21" />

Despite the cutthroat intra-family competition that existed among wampas for territorial control, the creatures nevertheless possessed a strong affinity for kinship. [[The galaxy/Legends|Galactic]] scientists discovered that wampas were very protective of their own and mourned their dead with great intensity. In the instance one was slain, the creatures would fly into destructive rages directed at the killer. If the death was natural, wampas would instead vent their rage on their surroundings, sometimes smashing cave walls or ripping apart anyone or anything within reach. Reports told of some wampas, in their bouts of hysteria, unwittingly causing avalanches and underground cave-ins, causing only more deaths. When the grieving wampas' energy finally subsided, they would bury their dead in the snow, keeping guard over it for several days to make sure nothing ate the remains.<ref name="NEGAS" /> If a wampa was injured, the rest of its pack would band together to repel the threat.<ref name="SEL">{{CCG|set=Special Edition Limited|cardname=One-Arm}}</ref>

[[File:Wampachase-woswfg.jpg|thumb|left|270px|Wampas were primarily solitary predators but hunted in packs on occasion.]]
Although they primarily hunted alone, some wampas occasionally hunted in packs, banding together to attack a threat to the local wampa community, such as a [[Human/Legends|Human]] settlement.<ref name="NEGAS" /> During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], for example, amidst the combined [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]&ndash;[[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] occupation of Hoth, many wampas of all ages gathered in different series of subterranean ice caves.<ref name="TOR: Forcing Their Hand: Destruction">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Forcing Their Hand: Destruction|Hoth}}</ref><ref name="TOR: The Bone Pits">{{TORcite|type=class|Imperial Agent|The Bone Pits|Hoth}}</ref> Many years later, during the Galactic Civil War, the Rebel Alliance occupation of Hoth drove many wampas to convene in and inhabit a large secluded [[Wampa Valley|valley]] surrounded by rocks and ice. The valley floor was littered with the remains of creatures who ventured into the wampas' home, never to escape.<ref name="Galaxies Chapter 11" /><ref name="Secrets of Hoth" /> Outside of mating season, however, the detection of a common threat was the only time wampas grouped together.<ref name="Starships & Vehicles 38">{{StarshipsVehiclesCite|38|In A Galaxy Far, Far Away}}</ref> By coordinating their hunting actions, wampas demonstrated a rudimentary level of [[Sentience/Legends|intelligence]] and cunning, particularly in the capability to scout and determine their enemies' location and strength before formulating an attack.<ref name="NEGAS" /> The wampas' aptitude for massively coordinated attacks made the species one of the most cunning killers in the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]].<ref name="Starships & Vehicles 10">{{StarshipsVehiclesCite|10|In A Galaxy Far, Far Away}}</ref> However, despite wampas demonstrating some intelligence and social development, most respected scientists nevertheless doubted the species' sentience.<ref name="Under the Ice" />

Wampas were capable of emitting a terrifying hunting roar that could compete with Hoth's howling winds. Their howl was one of their greatest natural gifts, for it could blend in almost imperceptibly with the winds. Only the creatures themselves could tell the two sounds apart. Thus, the howl provided wampas with a highly efficient form of communication that often proved lethal to disoriented prey.<ref name="GG3" /> In one unique instance, the Force-sensitive wampa Ku-Kak was trained to naturally understand the [[Chevin (language)|Chevin]].<ref name="A Mon Alone" />

During the Republic occupation of Hoth in the Cold War, a group of [[Talz/Legends|Talz]] established a supply cache in a [[Ice Behemoth Cave|large cave]] that many wampas had overrun. However, the wampas within the cave did not show hostility toward the Talz,<ref name="TOR: Forcing Their Hand: Destruction" /> a species of white-furred beings from the frozen planet [[Alzoc III/Legends|Alzoc III]],<ref name="NEGAS" /> due to the physical similarities between the two, for the wampas believed themselves and the Talz to be one and the same.<ref name="TOR: Forcing Their Hand: Destruction" />

==History==
{{Quote|Hey! Steady, girl. Hey, what's the matter? You smell something?|Luke Skywalker calms his nervous tauntaun before a wampa attack|audio=Wampa-Attack.flac|<ref name="ESB" />}}
===Cold War encounters===
Wampas roamed Hoth's frozen surface as early as [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Time">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> during the final years of the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Empire.<ref name="The Old Republic">{{TORcite|Hoth Environment}}</ref> Prior [[Battle of Hoth (Great Galactic War)|conflict]] in the [[Hoth system/Legends|Hoth system]] between the two sides left the planet a [[Starship Graveyard (Hoth)|graveyard]] of downed [[Starship/Legends|starship]] wreckage, which attracted salvaging pirates and, eventually, both the Republic and the Empire to return to reclaim their war machines, bringing with them renewed hostilities to Hoth's surface<ref name="Hoth Holonet">{{Holonet|planets|hoth|Hoth}}</ref>&mdash;and encounters by all with the planet's native ice creatures.<ref name="The Old Republic" />

Hoth's alpha predators proved a surprisingly intelligent peril to the planet's newcomers, especially unwary travelers wandering too close to unexplored ice caves. Multiple combat patrols disappeared after seeking shelter in a cavern thought to be unoccupied. Horror stories of men swallowed whole by towering wampa ice creatures made the rounds among new arrivals to Hoth.<ref name="Codex: Wampa">{{TORcite|type=codex|Wampa}}</ref> According to reports during that era, wampas numbered among some of Hoth's most hostile wildlife to call the [[Clabburn Tundra]] home during the war. Disturbed by the occupiers' encroachment on their habitat, wampas preyed on entire [[Squad/Legends|squads]] of [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]].<ref name="Codex: Clabburn Tundra">{{TORcite|type=codex|Clabburn Tundra}}</ref> Wampas also roamed among Hoth's [[Whiterock Wastes]], [[Highmount Ridge]], and [[Glacial Fissure]] areas.<ref name="The Old Republic" />

[[File:Wampa-TOR.jpg|thumb|right|210px|Wampas preyed on Republic, Imperial, and pirate soldiers alike during the Cold War.]]
The [[Hailstorm Brotherhood]], a radical tribe of wilderness survivalists, were one of several pirate groups to gain purchase on Hoth. Republic forces on the planet first learned of the brotherhood from [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] who, while investigating a massive [[Chilling Death Spire|ice spire]] sculpture that the pirates had erected, reported encounters with half-naked warriors wearing wampa furs as they charged into combat.<ref name="Codex: The Hailstorm Brotherhood">{{TORcite|type=codex|The Hailstorm Brotherhood}}</ref> Master [[Sav]], leader of the brotherhood, was once stranded and left for dead in wampa territory by Imperial forces, only to strangle one of the beasts with a tauntaun [[Bone/Legends|femur]] and skin it with one of its own claws, eventually making his way back to safety<ref name="TOR: Give Them An Inch">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|Give Them An Inch|Hoth}}</ref> three [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] later.<ref name="TOR: Razing the Ice Fortress">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Razing the Ice Fortress|Hoth}}</ref> Sav's wampa ordeal made him a legend among his pirate brethren.<ref name="TOR: Give Them An Inch" />

During the war [[Shai Tenna]], a [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] leader of the [[White Maw]] pirate organization, ran a sizable [[Shai Tenna's pleasure den|pleasure den]] within Hoth's Highmount Ridge, connected to which was an ice cave in which Tenna had trapped more than two dozen wampas of all ages as his "pets." After the Republic's [[Havoc Squad]], sent to Hoth on a mission to acquire one of the Empire's enigmatic [[Black cipher|Umbra encrypters]], made a failed attempt to infiltrate Tenna's group, the Weequay pirate had them thrown into the cave to be fed to the wampas. However, Havoc Squad fought its way through the wampa onslaught, defeating the creatures and making it out of the cave to freedom.<ref name="TOR: Wampa Stomp">{{TORcite|type=bonus|Wampa Stomp|Hoth}}</ref>

While seeking refuge from Hoth's brutal elements, a Republic Talz [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit and a group of wounded [[Republic soldier]]s fell under attack from wampas in their area. The Talz escaped from the attacking beasts, but the wampas dragged the Republic soldiers back to their [[Glacier Breaker Wampa Den|den]]. At the behest of [[Kuthak]], one of the Talz commandos, a Republic agent located the wampas' den, defeated the beasts inside, and rescued the wounded Republic soldiers from the wampas' clutches.<ref name="TOR: Wampa Chow">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|Wampa Chow|Hoth}}</ref> To ensure no Republic soldier met the same fate again, the agent proceeded to kill the remaining wampas in the cave.<ref name="TOR: Breaking the Glacier Breakers">{{TORcite|type=bonus|Breaking the Glacier Breakers|Hoth}}</ref>

Wampas again attacked a Republic reconnaissance squad that was investigating nearby caves and the took the scout team back to their [[Ice Claw Wampa Den|den]]. Concerned both for his missing men and whatever may have attacked them as a looming threat to other Republic forces on Hoth, [[Gavon Kroan]] assigned a Republic agent to help the scouts. The agent successfully rescued the Republic scout team from the wampa den.<ref name="TOR: Frozen Search and Rescue">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|Frozen Search and Rescue|Hoth}}</ref>

A legendary wampa called the [[White Terror]] prowled Hoth's wastes during the Cold War, stalking whatever prey the conflict brought its way. While hunting for food, the White Terror once encountered the Jedi [[Kaiya Stas]], who recognized that the wampa's path was taking it straight toward a colony of [[Ortolan/Legends|Ortolans]]. The White Terror wounded Stas in a failed attempt to stop the creature's approach. She later asked a Republic agent to destroy the wampa, warning that if the creature discovered a convenient source of food in the Ortolans, it would not stop its rampage until it wiped out the entire colony. The agent found the White Terror in the same den where wampas had previously taken the team of Republic scouts, and drew the wampa out from its lair by activating a [[sonic agitator]]. The agent then killed the White Terror, saving the Ortolan colonists.<ref name="TOR: I Came, I Froze, I...">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|I Came, I Froze, I...|Hoth}}</ref>

One of the Sith's weapons on Hoth during the war centered on a [[Beast-Lord]] of the planet [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] named [[Brutann]], whose mastery of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] enabled him to control Hoth's most vicious predators, including the wampa. Brutann gathered an [[Army/Legends|army]] of Hoth beasts aimed to destroy the Republic forces on the planet. Tasked by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Heljus]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] learner, [[Elsor]], to stop Brutann, a Republic agent traveled to the [[Jagged Plains Cavern]], where the agent defeated the Beast-Lord<ref name="TOR: The Beast Lord">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|The Beast Lord|Hoth}}</ref> and his [[Force-dominated wampa]], among other creatures.<ref name="TOR: Predatory Creatures">{{TORcite|type=bonus|Predatory Creatures|Hoth}}</ref>

Another group operating on Hoth, a collection of ex-[[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] called the [[Terror Brigade]], became known among the Republic forces for their efforts to find new and wild combat thrills, which included wrestling wampas. The Terror Brigade captured Imperial [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Yoren]] and offered to hand him over to the Republic on the condition that someone could survive their so-called "[[Onslaught (Terror Brigade)|Onslaught]]," a series of combat trials against progressively powerful opponents, both animal and [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]]. A Republic agent undertook the task of going up against the Onslaught within their [[Lake Algid Holdout|compound]],<ref name="TOR: The Terror Brigade">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|Terror Brigade|Hoth}}</ref> battling and defeating the Terror Brigade and the wampas they kept as part of the trial, among other combatants.<ref name="The Onslaught of Terror">{{TORcite|type=bonus|The Onslaught of Terror|Hoth}}</ref> In the challenge's final trial, the agent engaged in an extended battle with a large wampa named [[Ujooku]], killing the beast and defeating the Onslaught.<ref name="TOR: The Terror Brigade" />

[[File:WampaAttack-TOR.jpg|thumb|left|305px|Wampas attack an Imperial agent in tandem in the Bone Pits.]]
In another wampa assault, the [[Imperial Agent]] "[[Cipher Nine]]" journeyed to a large cave system in the Hoth glacial fissure known as the [[Bone Pits]] on a mission in conjunction with the Imperial-allied [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] to perform surveillance on the rogue Imperial [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Layek Davos]], who was meeting secretly with a [[Marauders (White Maw)|group of pirates]] for his own ends. Cipher Nine found the Bone Pits to be filled with nearly two dozen adult wampas clustered in the cave. Cipher Nine's spying of Davos's meeting with the pirates was interrupted when two of the beasts suddenly charged the agent's position, but Cipher Nine defeated both wampas. The agent proceeded to complete the surveillance mission<ref name="TOR: The Bone Pits" /> and eliminate the largest wampas still remaining in the cave,<ref name="TOR: Wampa Smash">{{TORcite|type=bonus|Wampa Smash|Hoth}}</ref> before then slipping back out.<ref name="TOR: The Bone Pits" />

A number of Republic Talz set up a supply cache of ordnance, food, and medical equipment within the Ice Behemoth Cave, which was also overrun by many wampas both young and old. The wampas inhabiting the cave, however, displayed no aggression toward their Talz occupiers, believing the white-furred [[Alien/Legends|aliens]] to be wampas themselves as a result of the species' shared physical attributes. Upon discovering the site of the Talz supply cache, Imperial [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Tritan]] tasked a group of agents with destroying their supplies in order to force the aliens into an assault, in which they could be destroyed. However, Tritan warned the agents of the danger in reaching the cache among the wampa cave and suggested that they not weigh themselves down when going against the ice creatures.<ref name="TOR: Forcing Their Hand: Destruction" /> The agents proceeded to kill many of the wampas<ref name="TOR: Forcing Their Hand: Destruction" /><ref name="TOR: Forced In">{{TORcite|type=bonus|Forced In|Hoth}}</ref> en route to destroying the Talz cache.<ref name="TOR: Forcing Their Hand: Destruction" />

During the Battle of Hoth in the Great Galactic War, which precipitated further conflict on the planet during the Cold War, the Empire lost an ancient [[Unidentified Sith holocron (Hoth)|Sith holocron]] thought to be destroyed, but which resurfaced years later in Hoth's starship graveyard, within the den of a [[Unidentified wampa (Sith holocron)|hulking wampa]]. In a mission managed by Imperial [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Kanen]], an Imperial agent entered the den and recovered the [[Sith holocron/Legends|holocron]] from the wampa after killing the creature.<ref name="TOR: Frozen in Time">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Frozen in Time|Hoth}}</ref>

An Imperial [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] named [[Soleks]] could not complete a mission to set up [[warning beacon]]s around a massive Hoth sinkhole in the Clabburn Tundra because his work area turned out to be a wampa hunting ground, driving him away. Soleks instead handed the duty off to an Imperial agent, who<ref name="TOR: Eyes on the Enemy">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Eyes on the Enemy|Hoth}}</ref> cleared the Clabburn Tundra area of wampas<ref name="TOR: A Sinking Fear">{{TORcite|type=bonus|A Sinking Fear|Hoth}}</ref> and successfully installed the warning beacons.<ref name="TOR: Eyes on the Enemy" /> Wampas also mauled a response team sent by Imperial Captain [[Viatar]] to stop Republic sappers from destabilizing the icy foundations of an [[Jagged Plains Imperial Garrison|Imperial garrison]] on the planet.<ref name="TOR: Taking the Heat">{{TORcite|type=heroic|Taking the Heat|Hoth}}</ref>

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
At some point an Imperial agent also killed up to five wampas in Hoth's Glacial Fissure sector.<ref name="TOR: Wampa Interference">{{TORcite|type=bonus|Wampa Interference|Hoth}}</ref>
{{Endgame}}

Around [[3638 BBY]],<ref name="ROTHC date">{{TOR_updates|2.0}}</ref> several wampas were affected by a [[Seeds of Rage|Seed of Rage]], a [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alchemical]] [[Sith artifact/Legends|artifact]] planted in the northern reaches of the Glacial Fissure region, and they underwent significant physical changes. The infected wampas developed grey-black growths on their bodies, while their eyes turned red and their fur became black and gray.<ref name="Buried">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=faction|Republic|Buried Evil|Hoth}}</ref>

===During the Clone Wars===
Millennia later, in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="Frozen Time">"[[Frozen Out!]]" is set after "[[Heroes on Both Sides]]" ([[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]]), as "''[[Deadly Droid]]''" mentions the [[Bombing of Coruscant's central power distribution grid/Legends|Bombing of Coruscant's central power distribution grid]]. Considering that the [[Star Wars comic books|comics]] featured in [[Star Wars Comic|''Star Wars Comic UK'']] are published in chronological order, it can be concluded that "''Frozen Out!''" takes place in 21 BBY.</ref> [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] were stranded on Hoth after their transport was shot down. They were pursued by a squad of [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]]. Kenobi and Binks imitated the call of tauntauns, which drew in wampas to attack the droids. The pair were able to escape in the chaos.<ref name="Frozen Out">{{TCWComicCite|6.34|Frozen Out!}}</ref>

A wampa was also collected by [[Kenna]] and stored aboard his [[Kenna's starship|starship]] in [[Carbon-freezing/Legends|carbon freeze]]. It was among the beasts [[Mission to an abandoned planetoid|freed]] by [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] to defeat him.<ref name="Collector comic">{{TCWComicCite|6.42|The Collector}}</ref>

===Kyrisa, wampa master===
{{Quote|I thought they only hunted when they were hungry?''"<br />"''They do what that Nightsister trains them to do.|Imperial Security Bureau Captain Jeffren Brek's team discusses Kyrisa's trained wampas|<ref name="TNR Dark Side scenario">{{SWGTCG|set=The Nightsister's Revenge|scenario=Dark Side scenario campaign}}</ref>}}
Circa early [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], the Force-sensitive [[Witches of Dathomir|Dathomiri]] [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] [[Kyrisa]] took refuge on Hoth after being exiled from her [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]].<ref name="TNR Light Side scenario">{{SWGTCG|set=The Nightsister's Revenge|scenario=Light Side scenario campaign}}</ref> Kyrisa, strong in the [[Force power/Legends|Force power]] of [[Animal bond|beast mastery]],<ref name="TNR Dark Side scenario" /> soon gained command of a pack of the ice planet's native wampas through mind control.<ref name="TNR Kyrisa">{{SWGTCG|set=The Nightsister's Revenge|cardname=Kyrisa}}</ref> Cut off from her home and her family on Dathomir, Kyrisa depended on one of her wampas for physical and emotional warmth.<ref name="TNR Harmonious Understanding">{{SWGTCG|set=The Nightsister's Revenge|cardname=Harmonious Understanding}}</ref> Aside from beast control, Kyrisa also dabbled in [[Bioengineering/Legends|genetic engineering]], through which she eventually produced a gigantic wampa of unnatural size, Unkajo.<ref name="TNR Dark Side scenario" /><ref name="TNR Unkajo">{{SWGTCG|set=The Nightsister's Revenge|cardname=Unkajo}}</ref>

[[File:KyrisaWampa-TheNightsistersRevenge.jpg|thumb|right|235px|The exiled Nightsister Kyrisa and a wampa under her control]]
Kyrisa used her mind-controlled wampas to devastate nearby installations and to steal supplies. However, as complete control as Kyrisa had over her pack of wampas, her beast mastery quickly attracted the attention of both the Galactic Empire and Jedi sympathetic to the Rebel Alliance, who hoped to either harness her knowledge or remove Kyrisa as a threat to Hoth's local population.<ref name="TNR Dark Side scenario" />

[[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] [[Director of Imperial Intelligence|leader]] [[Cronal|"Blackhole"]] had his own ideas how to employ Kyrisa's beast mastery and dispatched a team of [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] agents, led by Captain [[Jeffren Brek]], to capture her. During their search for Kyrisa on Hoth, Brek's team encountered two of the Nightsister's trained wampas, as well as the giant wampa Unkajo, who towered over its smaller brethren, prompting a skirmish between the Imperials and Kyrisa's beasts. Brek's team killed both of the two smaller wampas, before hamstringing and, as they believed, finally killing Unkajo as well, although the wampas knocked at least one of Brek's men out cold. After the skirmish, the Imperial agents collected the wampas' teeth and claws as souvenirs.<ref name="TNR Dark Side scenario" />

Only moments later, Kyrisa herself appeared before the Imperial agents, surrounded by another pack of obedient wampas, like an army of trained soldiers. Enraged at the loss of Unkajo, Kyrisa ordered the wampas to kill the Imperial team. However, the second battle turned out little different than the previous, with many more of the trained wampas being slain, before Kyrisa slipped away, with the surviving wampas of her group covering her escape.<ref name="TNR Dark Side scenario" />

Simultaneous with the Imperial mission, the Twi'lek Jedi Knight [[Rachi Sitra]], along with another Rebel agent, embarked on her own mission to capture the dangerous Kyrisa from Hoth.<ref name="TNR Light Side scenario" /> At some point, Sitra ran into one of Kyrisa's trained wampas as well, although her combat skills served her well in the fight with the attacking beast.<ref name="TNR Wampa Fight">{{SWGTCG|set=The Nightsister's Revenge|cardname=Wampa Fight}}</ref> The Rebel agent party to Sitra also encountered Kyrisa herself and two of the exiled Nightsister's trained wampas. Enraged at the Rebel agent for having previously killed [[Maraki|another]] of her bioengineered beasts, Kyrisa ordered the two wampas under her command to kill the agent. The two wampas, well-trained, fought to the death to defend their master, but the Rebel agent eventually won the battle and drove Kyrisa away for the time being.<ref name="TNR Light Side scenario" />

Ultimately, the [[Dark side adept/Legends|Dark Side Adept]] [[Namman Cha]] convinced Kyrisa to join him in service of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].<ref name="TNR Dark Side scenario" /> He, too, however, had his own bout with Kyrisa's wampas while searching for her on Hoth before enlisting her as the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor's]] newest prize.<ref name="TNR Reptomammal Battle">{{SWGTCG|set=The Nightsister's Revenge|cardname=Reptomammal Battle}}</ref>

===The attack on Echo Base===
{{Quote|Had we remained longer on that frozen world, I have no doubt we would have had more nights filled with their horror.|Voren Na'al|<ref name="TrilogySourcebook" />}}
The Rebel Alliance established its secret [[Alliance High Command/Legends|headquarters]] on Hoth during the Galactic Civil War following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], in a series of ice caves that came to be known as [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]].<ref name="GG3" /> Hoth's wampas soon enough became a serious threat to the Rebels, repeatedly attacking the base and its personnel.<ref name="NEGAS" />

{{RPGseed}}
In 2 ABY, as Echo Base neared completion,<ref name="Date">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]'' states that the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] is "nearing completion, but is already in partial operation" and that "[[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]] has recently settled into the facility." ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma's]] decision to establish the Rebel command headquarters on Hoth and Echo Base's completion to [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], thereby establishing the [[Time/Legends|time]] frame for ''Strongholds of Resistance''.</ref> a group of Rebels were tasked with clearing caverns of wampas so that the base could expand into that area. Required to contend with Hoth's treacherous icy caverns with seemingly bottomless chasms, the Rebels at first encountered and neutralized single wampas. They eventually discovered a large wampa lair, eliminating the creatures' presence from the area.<ref name="Strongholds of Resistance">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref>
{{Endgame}}

During a bivouac while scouting the expanses of Hoth shortly after the final construction of Echo Base was completed, Rebel [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Kem Monnon/Legends|Kem Monnon]], head of the [[Alliance Corps of Engineers/Legends|Alliance Corps of Engineers]] responsible for the base's construction, and an outfit of men heard the howls of wampas in the night&mdash;one of the first encounters, albeit indirect, between the creatures and the Rebels of Echo Base.<ref name="ISWU">''[[The Illustrated Star Wars Universe]]''</ref>

[[File:OneArm-ESB.png|thumb|left|260px|Maimed by Luke Skywalker's lightsaber, a wampa howls in agony.]]
The [[Alliance Survey Team Theta]] at some point found on Hoth the personal logs of a smuggler named [[Jonox Forb]], who inhabited the naturally formed ice caves before their conversion into Echo Base. Although the fate of Forb's smuggling band remained unclear, the Rebel survey team reportedly recovered the logs from an abandoned wampa lair. The content of Forb's logs were not publicly revealed until the release of former Echo Base [[General/Legends|General]] [[Carlist Rieekan/Legends|Carlist Rieekan's]] [[Rieekan Historical Collection|personal historical records]], which detailed the Rebellion's time spent on Hoth, during the later years of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="Under the Ice" />

As a measure of security, the Rebel Alliance's Standard Operating Procedure at Echo Base included scouting the barren wastes surrounding the facility. Initially, the Rebels detected only passive lifeforms, and there seemed to be very little danger on the remote ice planet. The first sign the Rebels saw that they were not alone was the discovery of a dead tauntaun just outside the base. When the dead animal was brought before [[2-1B/Legends|2-1B]], the base's chief [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droid]], he determined that the tauntaun's neck had been snapped. Knowing how strong the stubborn animals were, the base's personnel found the thought that some creature was strong enough to do such damage more than frightening.<ref name="GG3" /> 2-1B also assisted in an Echo Base investigation that led to the discovery and capture of several wampas from a nearby cave.<ref name="Who's Who">{{InsiderCite|74|Who's Who in Echo Base: The Unsung Rebels of the Battle of Hoth}}</ref>

Soon thereafter, Luke Skywalker and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] were on a routine mission to place sensor beacons around the perimeter of the base. Solo informed Skywalker that he had encountered an animal carcass, which he believed to be a recent wampa kill, and urged Skywalker to be on guard before he headed back to Echo Base. Solo later told base personnel that he had discovered some wampa kills out in the snow.<ref name="ESB radio">[[The Empire Strikes Back (radio)|''The Empire Strikes Back'' radio drama]]</ref> Skywalker, however, failed to report in from his scouting work, as he was attacked by a [[Unidentified wampa/Legends|male wampa]] while astride his tauntaun. The wampa landed a crushing blow to Skywalker's face with a swipe of its powerful claw, knocking him unconscious and opening up a gash on the side of his face. His tauntaun was killed instantly with a crushing grip that snapped its neck. When Skywalker awoke, he found himself hanging upside down, his feet frozen to the ceiling of the creature's cave, and another wampa eating the corpse of his mount.<ref name="SWCL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> Skywalker was able to escape the cave using the Force to pull his lightsaber into his hands, cutting himself down from the ceiling, then cutting off the creature's arm with his lightsaber just as it was about to attack him.<ref name="ESB" />

After Skywalker revived from his medical treatment inside a [[Bacta tank/Legends|bacta tank]], he confirmed the Rebels' worst fears. He described being attacked by a large creature three meters in height with deadly claws. Although he had only knowingly seen one of the beasts, where there was one, the Rebels reasoned, there was likely to be more. As a result, the base immediately stepped up its security measures.<ref name="GG3" />

[[File:Wampa_Echo_Base.jpg|thumb|right|205px|A wampa attacks Rebel soldiers in Echo Base.]]
Echo Base sent out a few patrols to locate the creature that wounded Skywalker. Although they failed to find Skywalker's one-armed attacker, they did encounter another wampa. After stalking the Rebels for some time, the wampa finally attacked the group from its cover beneath a snow mound, surprising its prey. The wampa continued to make hit-and-run attacks at the Rebels, trying to take its prey one being at a time, unwilling to allow such a significant amount of food to get away.<ref name="Rebellion Era Sourcebook">''[[Rebellion Era Sourcebook]]''</ref>

The evening after Skywalker's recovery, Echo Base came under attack. It started with the sound of howling, a noise not unusual to those in the base, who were accustomed to Hoth's howling winds. Still, this noise was louder and angrier. Shortly after the howling started, the base's command center received a brief [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] call from [[Bervin]], a perimeter scout, which was abruptly cut off by a bellowing inhuman roar and a horrified, distinctly Human scream. Major [[Bren Derlin/Legends|Bren Derlin]], head of security at Echo Base, and others in the command center rushed to Bervin's post. There, they found only the signs of a struggle, but no sign of Bervin himself. Blood was splattered against the far wall of snow, where a large cave-in had occurred. The blood trail followed the shallow trench where Bervin's body had been dragged out of the post and into the icy night of Hoth.<ref name="GG3" />

Before long similar calls began to come into the command center. Attacks all along the base's perimeter were reported. All described the same: a lone sentry, attacked and dragged off into the night. Efforts were made to ready the base's [[Snowspeeder/Legends|snowspeeders]], but there was no need. The creatures came to them, crashing through the carefully carved ice walls of the facility. The base was soon filled with a horde of attacking wampas. The personnel of Echo Base were ready to protect their fortress, however. They held off the beasts with concentrated [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]] barrages, while the wampas outside the base were similarly repelled by the Rebels' blaster fire. The creatures inside the base were rounded up with the help of the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]]. At the heart of each attack was one commonality that had gone unnoticed until the droids brought it to the attention of Major Derlin. They noticed that the high-pitched beeps of the base's [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droids]] drove the wampas into rages. The Rebels were able to use recordings of astromech droids to drive the creatures out of their dark, icy crevasses. They stunned the wampas into incapacitation, and stored them in heavily shielded pens in less vital sections of Echo Base. The pen doors were marked with yellow and orange warning signs, nicknamed by those in the base as "do not disturb" signs. The Rebels believed that the wampas had attacked the base to defend themselves from what they perceived as an invasion of their territory.<ref name="GG3" /> Additionally, research later revealed that the astromech droids' high-pitched beeps and wails were similar to the sounds made by females in search of a mate. This further explained the wampas' rampages, with males having discovered pieces of metal machinery after thinking they had discovered a new companion.<ref name="NEGAS" />

===Battle of Hoth===
{{Quote|Rebel troops?''"<br />"''I don't think so, sir.|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] and a [[Cold assault stormtrooper|snowtrooper]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] discuss Echo Base's caged wampas|<ref name="OSA">{{WEGCite|story=One Step Ahead|book=Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back (Second Edition)}}</ref>}}
The Galactic Empire discovered the Rebels' hidden Echo Base in the immediate aftermath of the wampa assault on the ice facility through the reconnaissance efforts of a remotely deployed [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd]] [[Viper probe droid/Legends|Viper probe droid]].<ref name="GG3" /> While performing its reconnaissance work of the ice planet prior to detecting the Rebel presence on Hoth and transmitting its accompanying sensor data back to the Empire, the [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droid]] discovered a large mound of snow in the Hoth wastes. Upon the droid probing the mound with a low-powered [[Laser/Legends|laser]] beam, a large wampa emerged from the snow pile, having been [[Sleep/Legends|sleeping]] there. The probe droid quickly regulated the potency of its high-powered [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] and disintegrated the beast with a single blast.<ref name="ESB novel" />

[[File:Unkajo-TNR.jpg|thumb|left|220px|The giant wampa Unkajo]]
While hunting a herd of grazing tauntauns, another wampa also encountered and attacked another Imperial Viper probe droid scouting the planet. After a short clash between [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] and claws, the wampa defeated the droid and dragged it back to its ice cavern, where it suspended the machine in the icy ceiling above the skeletal remains of former prey.<ref name="Hoth">{{Tales|5|Hoth (comic story)}}</ref>

During the desperate haste to escape Echo Base in the face of the Imperial invasion during the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], C-3PO came upon one of the pen doors while trying to catch up with Solo, [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], and the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] on their way to the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']]. Knowing an advance group of [[Cold assault stormtrooper|snowtroopers]] was directly behind him, Threepio tore off the door's warning label and proceeded to disappear around another bend in the corridor. The pursuing troopers reached the door. Their leader punched the controls to slide it open, knowing it would take more than locks to stop an Imperial advance. The group marched into the pen with military efficiency, only to be slaughtered by the caged wampas. Once [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] reached the room, all he saw were piles of blood-stained snow, a cave-in exposing the pen to Hoth's daytime [[Hoth (star)/Legends|sun]], and some of his most seasoned, well-trained troops dead on the ground.<ref name="GG3" />

In the chaos during the battle, the primary entrance point the wampas used to infiltrate and attack Echo Base, a small room off one of the main corridors that had been sealed, was uncovered. The entrance point opened to a small tunnel that led to the large valley where many of the wampas lived and, consequently, where the attacking wampas had originated. As the battle raged, a visitor to Echo Base followed this tunnel into the large snowy valley, where, in a nearby camp, he found one [[Professor/Legends|Professor]] [[Blainekie]], a Rebel researcher investigating the wampas in the vicinity. Blainekie required assistance with defeating the valley's wampas, including the giant wampa Unkajo. The Echo Base visitor complied and successfully brought down the towering creature.<ref name="Galaxies Chapter 11" /><ref name="Secrets of Hoth" />

While attempting to escape from Hoth late during the battle, [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Dash Rendar/Legends|Dash Rendar]] encountered several of the Rebels' caged wampas throughout the bowels of Echo Base.<ref name="SOTE">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (video game)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' video game]]</ref> After witnessing the havoc wreaked upon the base by the wampas, the Empire in turn bioengineered the cliff wampa to guard [[Cadavine Sector Fleet Imperial Enclave|Imperial interests]] on the Gall moon.<ref name="NEGAS" />

===Hunting wampas for sport===
{{Quote|There's a huge black-market price on wampa pelts, you know.|Burrk|<ref name="Darksaber" />}}
A certain subclass of [[Big game hunter/Legends|big-game hunters]] existed who specialized in the "sporting" hunt of large predators like the wampa. They often traveled to the remote Hoth [[Star system/Legends|system]] to hunt wampas.<ref name="Wampa Databank" /> Poachers and hunters had been tracking wampas for decades prior to the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|onset]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], though their mortality rate often exceeded the creatures themselves.<ref name="Maul: Lockdown" /> Wampa pelts or stuffed heads were prized trophies among hunters,<ref name="GG3" /> and a [[Black market/Legends|black-market]] fur-[[Merchant/Legends|trading]] operation that involved wampas existed in the Outer Rim at some point before [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]].<ref name="Maul: Lockdown" /> Wampa "souvenirs" and even [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] made of wampa fur had been known to command high prices at galactic trading posts by the early years of the Galactic Civil War.<ref name="GG3" /> Wampa meat was also served in some corners of the galaxy&mdash;as of [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], a serving kitchen within the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Darkside (space station)|Darkside]] on an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] in the [[Cularin asteroid belt]] had twenty kilograms of ground lean wampa meat stored in a freezer.<ref name="MidWorld">{{LivingForce|Between the Worlds: MidWorld}}</ref> By [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], the sporting hunt of wampas was illegal,<ref name="ISWU" /> though hunters were still able to sell their wares on the black market for high gain.<ref name="Darksaber" /> Wampas were later included in [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] legislation to protect endangered species from extinction.<ref name="NEGAS" />

[[File:Wampa_NEGAS.jpg|thumb|right|200px|A wampa]]
In one well-known case, the wampas' ability to organize coordinated attacks was well demonstrated. A group of failed [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] cadets established a business as guides leading these big-game hunters in pursuit of Hoth's wampas. Initially, they met with great success due to their advanced weaponry. However, by the fourth expedition the wampas had learned their enemy's secrets. The hunters landed and set out in search of their quarry. Meanwhile, the wampas found and destroyed the expedition's starship. Over the course of the next several nights, the wampas circled the camp, howling madly. The frightened hunters wasted their ammunition shooting at shadows until the wampas attacked. The beasts dragged away just one hunter with each assault. Finally, the last two survivors killed one another rather than allowing themselves to fall prey to the wampas.<ref name="ISWU" /><ref name="BTM" /> This was one tale typically told by big-game hunters; some circles doubted the validity of the tale, pointing to the loophole that if there were no survivors, no one could have lived to report what had happened.<ref name="ISWU" />

Skywalker later re-encountered the wampa he wounded with his lightsaber [[12 ABY/Legends|nine years later]] during a subsequent journey to Hoth with the Jedi Knight [[Callista Ming]]. There, they discovered a group of stranded wampa poachers, including a former stormtrooper named [[Burrk]], and two [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] brothers. The three had set up a business taking hunters to Hoth to hunt what they termed "the biggest game in the galaxy." The group found success after two hunting rounds, collecting the pelts of several creatures and killing numerous others. But on their third trek into the Hoth wilderness, the poachers met with disaster. They returned to their [[Starship/Legends|starship]] to find their [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] slaughtered. Trying to investigate the cause of death, the group was attacked by a group of wampas, killing a guide and three clients. The surviving five members found shelter in the abandoned Echo Base.<ref name="Darksaber" />

When Skywalker and Ming arrived on the planet just days later, the two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and five survivors were once again attacked by an army of wampas who had grouped together under the leadership of the [[Dismemberment/Legends|dismembered]] beast, who recognized Skywalker's and Ming's lightsabers as a threat. As a coordinated group, the wampas displayed enough intelligence to ruin the flight controls of the Jedi's ship, as they had with the poachers, to prevent escape. After the wampa horde chased the group back into the confines of Echo Base, the beasts created a diversion by banging on the base's closed shield doors until they could break through the icy walls of the facility. Skywalker and Ming were able to reach their damaged ship with the stopping power of their lightsabers&mdash;Skywalker killing the one-armed beast for good in the process&mdash;and escape the planet after rigging their vessel to restart through an alternative power source, but not before the remaining poachers were killed. Skywalker later remarked that he believed the one-armed wampa recognized him personally and that they consequently possessed long-term memories.<ref name="Darksaber" /><ref name="Wampa Databank" /><ref name="NEGAS" />

===Other encounters===
By [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]], a [[Shi'ido]] [[Changeling/Legends|Changeling]] impersonating the former [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]-turned-[[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Reess Kairn]] had set up a [[lumni-spice]] [[Mining/Legends|mining]] operation on Hoth using the planet's wampas as food-collecting servants. He fitted several of the creatures with a type of bio-stimulant [[Brain/Legends|brain]] implant, making them more docile and able to understand and respond to the Shi'ido's verbal commands. They were instructed to retrieve tauntauns and bring them back to his subterranean cave, where they were taught to skin them in preparation for his consumption. Hoping to collect a posted [[Bounty/Legends|price]] on Kairn's head, the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]] infiltrated the cave draped in the skinned hide of a dead wampa. She was able to neutralize the Kairn impersonator while simultaneously killing many of his wampas in a manufactured cave-in. The rocky collapse awakened a large [[dragon slug]], which also crushed one of the wampas in its massive jaws.<ref name="Aurra Sing">''[[The Bounty Hunters: Aurra Sing]]''</ref>

The [[Balti]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Bingo Mehndra]] possessed a captured pet wampa in a secret Hoth base of his. When the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] sent his [[Music/Legends|musical]] retainers, the [[Max Rebo Band/Legends|Max Rebo Band]], on a covert [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] mission to Hoth to kill Mehndra, the smuggler threatened to feed the [[Musician/Legends|musicians]] to his wampa if he suspected a trick.<ref name="Hot Time">{{Tales|6|A Hot Time in the Cold Town Tonite!}}</ref> The participants of Jabba the Hutt's demolition games later encountered a single wampa while competing on Hoth shortly before [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].<ref name="Demolition">''[[Star Wars: Demolition]]''</ref>

On a [[Mission to Hoth (Jaden Korr)|mission to Hoth]] in [[14 ABY/Legends|14 ABY]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kyle Katarn]]<ref name="Under the Ice" /> and his apprentice, [[Padawan/Legends|Jedi student]] [[Jaden Korr]], encountered several rogue wampas around the perimeter and inhabiting the ruins of Echo Base. Korr found one wampa in particular attacking a tauntaun within the base.<ref name="JK">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy]]''</ref>

==Wampas in the galaxy==
{{Quote|Stoopa! You said wampa protect me from intruders! Not kill me!&raquo; <br />&laquo;I&hellip;thought we could control it, Lord!|translated=1|A [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] and a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]], realizing the futility of trying to hold a captive wampa|<ref name="Republic 42">[[Star Wars (1998) 42|''Star Wars'' (1998) 42]]</ref>}}
[[File:SWREP42.jpg|thumb|left|190px|The interdicted wampa corners a young [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]] and [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] on [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]].]]
Knowledge of the wampa throughout the galaxy was limited.<ref name="ISWU" /><ref name="Maul: Lockdown" /> Of those aware of the creatures' existence, understanding typically came by way of overhearing big-game hunters speak of what they considered legendary quarry on account of the wampas' violence and formidable claws and teeth. Indeed, hyperbole and rumors of the wampa's fearsomeness abounded,<ref name="ISWU" /> to the point that the slang term "Wampameat" came to be used to refer to individuals who would soon experience great suffering.<ref name="SW:TRPG">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']]</ref> The planet Hoth was synonymous with the wampa&mdash;in the rare instances the planet was mentioned in conversation, it was common to hear the wampa mentioned in the same breath.<ref name="ISWU" />

Many believed that wampas possessed at least rudimentary intelligence. Through extensive research into the records of other creatures appearing similar to the wampa, evidence had been found suggesting mass coordinated attacks made by the creatures. In some cases, these attacks laid waste to entire outposts of colonists on other worlds. This was later substantiated by the Rebels of Echo Base.<ref name="GG3" />

Wampas were one of several "trophy" animals smuggled onto the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] for the pleasure of its [[Coruscanti/Legends|citizenry]]. As with their smuggled counterparts, these wampas were quickly discovered to be too dangerous to handle and were either released into the environment or escaped on their own, labeled from that point as "fugitive animals." These renegade wampas instinctively migrated to Coruscant's cooler polar regions to eke out an existence.<ref name="Wildlife" /> Wampas also existed on the Outer Rim ice world [[Rhen Var/Legends|Rhen Var]].<ref name="BFII">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]''</ref>

As of [[41 BBY/Legends|41 BBY]], the Galactic Republic prohibited the transportation of wampas throughout the galaxy. The [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Tholme/Legends|Tholme]] and his Padawan, [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]], were assigned to track a felonious dealer of interdicted beasts to the planet [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]], where they suspected their target was connected to the Twi'lek [[Clan Secura]]. Unbeknownst to the Jedi, the [[Unidentified Hutt crime lord (Aayla Secura's master)|Hutt crime lord]] presiding over the [[Slavery/Legends|slave trade]] on Ryloth held a captive wampa&mdash;one of the interdicted beasts&mdash;in the name of personal security, sold to it by [[Pol Secura]]. The wampa managed to break free of its restraints during the Jedi's visit, killing the Hutt and several others nearby. The young slave girl [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] was able to reach out [[Telepathy/Legends|telepathically]] through the Force to call to Vos for help during the confusion. He soon arrived at her side but found himself overmatched by the large beast after first naively trying to reason with it. On the brink of death within the wampa's grasp, Vos, with the assistance of the young Secura, called his lightsaber to his hand via the Force and put an end to the wampa's rampage. With Secura's sensitivity to the Force realized, she was taken to Coruscant to be trained as a Jedi.<ref name="Republic 42" />

Around [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="Republic 17">[[Star Wars (1998) 17|''Star Wars'' (1998) 17]]</ref> the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Gargonn]] the Hutt ran an enterprise shipping exotic beasts around the galaxy, operating the [[Circus Horrificus/Legends|Circus Horrificus]],<ref name="Fact File 140">{{FactFile|140|HUT 15-18|The Hutts}}</ref> a gruesome traveling show of alien monstrosities,<ref name="CSWE-Circus Horrificus">{{CSWECite|I|128|Circus Horrificus}}</ref> out of the bowels of the moon [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. Wampas listed among the many beasts included in Gargonn's animal smuggling ring.<ref name="Fact File 140" />

"Wampa" was a common species name used in the names of independent [[Starship/Legends|starships]] operating throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="SS">{{GamerCite|1|Shipbuilding Secrets}}</ref>

===Cog Hive Seven===
{{Quote|You weren't supposed to survive your match with the wampa.|[[Sadiki Blirr]], to Darth Maul|<ref name="Maul: Lockdown" />}}
The [[Realspace/Legends|space]] [[Prison/Legends|penitentiary]] known as [[Cog Hive Seven]] ran an extremely lucrative yet illicit [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] operation a decade and a half before the beginning of the Clone Wars. By forcibly pitting its [[Prisoner/Legends|inmates]] against each other in [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiatorial]] combat and betting on the matches using an elaborate algorithm to predetermine the winner of each bout, the prison made a fortune at the expense of the galactic gambling community. Cog Hive Seven eventually obtained a [[Unidentified wampa (Cog Hive Seven)|wampa]] from a couple of freelance bounty hunters, who delivered the creature to the prison from an [[Abandoned Anoat system spaceport|abandoned spaceport]] in the [[Anoat system/Legends|Anoat system]]. Believing the wampa to have previously fought in illegal gladiatorial contests, the prison's administration planned to match the beast against its own inmates.<ref name="Maul: Lockdown" /> The wampa was yet infected with a [[Disease/Legends|disease]] that greatly affected its physiology.<ref name="Schreiber Facebook">{{Facebook|username=starwarsbooks|url=starwarsbooks/posts/10152224073028713|name=[[Joe Schreiber]]|date=2014-02-12|quote=the idea with the wampa is (or was, in some version of the story) that it is, in fact, infected with something. I'm going to keep it vague in the interest of spoilers, but yeah&hellip;definitely not your average garden variety wampa.|nolive=1}} {{C|In response to: Could you explain exactly what your intentions were for the wampa?}}</ref>

In 33 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]], [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]], [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] of the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Sidious, infiltrated Cog Hive Seven on a mission for his [[Sith Master/Legends|Master]] by masquerading as an inmate, though he was forbidden to call upon the power of the Force or reveal his true identity as a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]]. Cog Hive Seven's algorithm soon matched Maul against the prison's wampa, a fight that Maul was calculated to lose, with the majority of offworld gambling combines betting that the odds were in the beast's favor. The wampa stood nearly three meters in height, with a battered physical appearance indicative of previous combat, including a filthy, blood-stained pelt that had been ripped away in spots along its chest and abdomen, and a cranial horn that had been partially snapped off. The fight began with the wampa slashing Maul twice with its claws. Maul retaliated but quickly came to the realization that there was indeed something profoundly wrong with the creature after driving his elbow into the wampa's skull with a force that should have broken its neck, to no effect. The disease that infected the wampa enabled it to continue fighting even after Maul shattered its skull with a subsequent head-butt, but Maul put an end to the match by driving his arms through the soft tissue of the wampa's torso and crushing its heart between his hands.<ref name="Maul: Lockdown" />

===Clone Wars===
[[File:Wampa_cw6.jpg|thumb|right|260px|A wampa confronts Asajj Ventress in the Cauldron on Rattatak.]]
Wampas were occasionally found participating in illegal gladiatorial games on a number of Outer Rim worlds.<ref name="NEGAS" /> Early during the Clone Wars, [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] faced a [[Cauldron wampa|wampa]], among other opponents, in [[the Cauldron]], an infamous gladiatorial arena on the rocky planet of [[Rattatak/Legends|Rattatak]]. She hoped to persuade [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] to accept her as his Sith apprentice by displaying her combat abilities.<ref name="Clone Wars - Chapter 6">{{CW|6}}</ref> In similar fashion, the Jedi Master [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]] faced off against a wampa in gladiatorial style combat while in the [[Arena of Doom]], a gladiator stadium owned by [[Mondo-Mod]] the Hutt, who had his wampa contestant shipped in directly from Hoth. Without using her lightsaber or Force abilities, Unduli defeated the beast by jumping, grabbing its horns, and flipping it. She attributed her victory to simple physics. For her victory over the wampa and subsequent opponents, Mondo-Mod revealed to her the location of a [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] factory on the planet [[Diorda]].<ref name="Versus">{{CWACite|8|Versus (comic story)}}</ref>

The [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Onaconda Farr/Legends|Onaconda Farr]], [[Senator/Legends|senator]] of the [[Doldur sector/Legends|Doldur sector]], possessed a wampa-skin rug during the Clone Wars. Farr kept the rug, comprising a stuffed head but bereft of appendages, within his retreat on the planet Rodia.<ref name="TCW:Agenda">''[[The Clone Wars: Agenda]]''</ref> Warm wampa-skin rugs of high quality immediately showed visitors to one's home that one was an individual of refined taste and class.<ref name="Galactic Hunters">{{SWGTCG|set=Galactic Hunters|cardname=Wampa-Skin Rug}}</ref>

On a tactical screen within a Republic ground base command center commanded by Anakin Skywalker at some point early during the Clone Wars, [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] lettering described a sort of wampa attack taking place. Also present within the base's command center was a chest with the Aurebesh lettering "HOT-."<ref name="TCW:Transfer">''[[The Clone Wars: Transfer]]''</ref> A [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry]] with a picture of a snarling Wampa on the front saw service with Republic forces during this period, and it was given the nickname ''[[Wampa Runner]]''.<ref name="Incredible Vehicles">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Incredible Vehicles]]''</ref>

[[File:Purple_Fur_Wampa_Suit.png|thumb|left|140px|A clone trooper dressed in a purple fur wampa suit for Halloween]]
A sizable community of wampas lived on [[Asuin]], a planet deep within [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] besieged by fierce ice storms, during the Clone Wars. [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and Anakin Skywalker landed on Asuin during the war while pursuing valuable stolen data containing the location of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]' [[hypermatter generator]]s. Upon touching down on Asuin's surface in dropped [[Landspeeder/Legends|speeders]], Kenobi and Skywalker quickly fell under attack by a large group upwards of ten wampas. The Jedi escaped the beasts by [[Force jump/Legends|leaping]] to the far side of a nearby ravine, leaving the wampas to push Skywalker's speeder into the deep chasm separating the two parties. Kenobi, specifically, recognized the creatures and referred to the wampas by species name.<ref name="Hunted">{{TCWComicCite|6.16|Hunted (comic story)}}</ref>

A particularly abrasive [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] used the handle "[[wampa1]]" as his user identification while posting comments on a [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] message thread during the height of the Clone Wars.<ref name="Destabilization">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/swlf20040105|text=Destabilization}}</ref><ref name="Academic Review">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/swlf20041007|text=Academic Review}}</ref><ref name="Everyone's a Critic">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/swlf20050331b|text=Everyone's a Critic}}</ref>

At some point during the Clone Wars, the [[Chevin/Legends|Chevin]] slaver [[Phylus Mon]] kept a single male wampa named Ku-Kak as a personal [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] in addition to several other retainers. Mon discovered the wampa on a distant ice-covered world and selected the beast into his employ due to its unique ability to wield the Force. Ku-Kak's training under Mon included understanding and being able to respond to his master's commands in the Chevin language and also to identify and attack Jedi, for whom Mon held a strong dislike. The wampa identified Jedi by the fact that they carried lightsabers, and because he differentiated them from [[Mischa Vorfren]], a male [[Anzat (species)|Anzati]] soldier also in Mon's employ who carried a lightsaber that Ku-Kak had collected as a trophy and given to him, and whom Ku-Kak considered an ally. To combat Jedi, Mon provided Ku-Kak with a [[Sith sword]] that he had picked up during his travels; the wampa proved very adept at wielding the sword, which augmented his powers in the dark side of the Force.
